title: Handle a missing value
objective: Use a value that may be missing, check for it with is nothing or is something, and return it from a function.

body.text: Some answers may not exist. first of gives the first item of a list, but an empty list has no first item, so the answer is nothing. A type written as a number or nothing can hold either a number or nothing. Check which one you have with is nothing or is something.

body.title: Check for a missing value
body.code:
make scores equal to keep a list of 3, 8 where it is greater than 9
make top equal to first of scores
if top is nothing
    say "No score is over 9."
otherwise
    say "Top score: {top}"

body.text: A function that may give back nothing says or nothing after its return type. To send a value out, use something with value. To send nothing out, use gives back nothing.

body.title: Return nothing when there is no answer
body.code:
function half
    takes number called n
    returns a decimal or nothing
    if n is less than 0
        gives back nothing
    gives back something with value n divided by 2

make answer equal to half -4
if answer is nothing
    say "Negative numbers have no half."

make other equal to half 6
if other is something
    say "Half of 6 is {other}"

body.prompt: A score is in the list, but the program prints nothing at all. Make it print Top score: 3.
body.starter:
make scores equal to a list of 3, 8
make top equal to first of scores
if top is nothing
    say "Top score: {top}"
body.solution:
make scores equal to a list of 3, 8
make top equal to first of scores
if top is something
